## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle Vinaya manual on the canonical practice of *shuōzuì* 說罪 (confession of offences) at the monthly *poṣadha* by **Yìjìng** 義淨 ([義淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E6%B7%A8), 635–713). Author signature: *唐三藏法師義淨撰*.

**Abstract**

The *Shuōzuì yàoxíng fǎ* completes the trio of Yìjìng's short Vinaya manuals ([KR6k0188](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0188), [KR6k0189](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0189), [KR6k0190](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0190)) and is the most operational of the three: it presents the actual ritual formulary for the *poṣadha* confession. The CANWWW alternative-title *Bié shuōzuì yàoxíng fǎ* 別說罪要行法 ("the *Distinct* Essential Method of Confessing Offences") is preserved in the canonical record (T45N1903 *alt* title) and indicates the manual's distinct status as a complement to the standard *poṣadha* karman recitation. Composition belongs to Yìjìng's post-695 Luòyáng / Chángān decades.
